name: Generic two-step launch control
source: [AS] ASSUMED generic aftermarket two-step: a second rev limit at 4000 rpm while the car is stationary (speedo below 2 m/s, so a pull-away is held until the car is clearly moving) with the clutch in at arming. No manufacturer data: 4000 rpm is a typical mid-range launch speed for a naturally aspirated 6500-8000 rpm engine, below every shipped engine's own limiter. Behaviour documented in docs/data_formats/electronics.md.
